pretreatments.description: Ozone pretreatment: Ozone was produced by a L11-L24 Ozone Generator manufactured by Pacific Ozone, CA, USA. Grass particles (3 g) were adjusted for moisture (90% w/w) and placed into an enclosed stainless steel reactor with 1 cm bed height for equal contact time. Ozone dosed at 0.79 g O3/g TS with 5.3% ozone concentration at 2000 ml/min flow rate for 10 min.

Soaking Aqueous Ammonia (SAA) pretreatment: Grass waste particles were soaked in 28-30% (w/w) ammonium hydroxide solution with solid-to-liquid ratio of 2:10 at 50 °C for 24 h without agitation in 1000 ml screw cap Pyrex solution bottle. After incubation, grass was washed twice thoroughly with distilled water to reach neutral pH, dried at 50 °C.

Ozone combined with SAA (OSAA) pretreatment: Grass waste particles were first pretreated by ozone pretreatment for 10 min using 5.3% ozone concentration at 2000 ml/min flow rate for 10 min, followed by SAA pretreatment for 6 h.
Size reduction: Milled grass waste particles were sieved through a 42 mesh Tyler Standard Screen Scale to obtain particles with size less than 0.354 mm.
